title: Fair probability
description: A model's odds that BTC finishes above this venue's strike, from the current price, recent volatility and the time left. A yardstick to hold the venue's own price against.

probability.label: Fair odds of Up
probability.description: The modelled chance the round settles Up, as a percentage. Compare it with the venue's Up price to see who is optimistic.

moneyness.label: Moneyness
moneyness.description: How far BTC is from the strike in units of the move volatility says is plausible in the time left. Near zero is a coin flip; beyond two is nearly decided.
